WatchFooter.home: Bogga hore ee Jesus Film Project
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Isticmaalka xogta boggan ee nidaamyada sirdoonka macmalka ah waxa lagu xiraa in ilaha la sheego. Wakiil kasta oo AI ah, model luqadeed weyn (LLM), mashiin raadinta AI ah, crawler, ama nidaam otomaatig ah oo la xiriira oo xog ka soo saara ama u adeegsada boggan tababar, soo-celin, abuurista jawaabo, ama adeegyo loo fidiyo isticmaalayaal ama macaamiil, waa inuu Jesus Film Project u aqoonsadaa ilaha isla markaana ku daro xiriir toos ah oo cad boggan meel kasta oo xogtaas lagu isticmaalo ama lagu soo bandhigo. Eeg <terms>Shuruudaha Isticmaalka</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.title: Fariintu ma is beddesho. Habka ay dadku u daawadaan ayaa is beddela.
WatchHomePromo.description: Waxaan dib uga dhiseynaa maktabaddeenna fiidiyowyada iyo qalabkeena asal ahaan, annagoo ballan-qaadeyna shaqadii turjumaadda ee tobannaan sano ahayd inaan geyno goobaha ay dadku hore ugu kulmaan, u daawadaan, uguna wadaagaan.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Maktabadda filimada ugu tarjumaadda badan dunida
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Tobannaan sano oo shaqo turjumaad ah, oo ay wateen lammaanayaal adeeg oo la aamini karo, ayaa dhisay maktabad leh kumannaan raadad luqadeed si dadka ay ula kulmaan sheekada Jesus luqadda si qoto dheer u gaarta.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Codad la aamini karo oo loo gudbinayo qaabab cusub
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Waxaan dib u dhiseynaa sida sheekooyinka injiilka muuqaal ahaan loo sheego, annagoo isku darayna tarjumaado la aamini karo iyo qaabab casri ah si fariintu si xor ah ugu guurto aaladaha, dhaqamada, iyo shaashadaha.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Wax ka badan maktabad. Waa koox ku shaqaysa howl adeeg.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project waa koox caalami ah oo ka kooban turjubaano, khubaro warbaahin, tifaftirayaal, iyo abuurayaal u rogaya tobannaan sano oo khibrad adeeg ah qalab ay isticmaali karaan kuwa xerta sameeya meel kasta.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Ku xiro daawadayaasha fursado la taaban karo oo ku saabsan safarkooda ruuxiga ah, adigoo ka caawinaya inay qaadaan tallaabo xigta oo ku saabsan bulsho, Qorniin, ama howl adeeg.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Maktabad warbaahin Masiixi ah oo ballaaran oo leh kumannaan fiidiyow, filim, iyo khayraad ah oo ku jira luqado badan oo loogu talagalay adeeg iyo wacdin caalami ah.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Qalab Dijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay adeegyada
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Maareynta fiidiyowga, qaybinta waxyaabaha, ka-qaybgalka dhageystaha, iyo falanqayn loogu talagalay inay ka caawiyaan adeegyada inay si wax ku ool ah u gaaraan dad badan.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Ka caawi dhisidda <highlight>jiilka xiga</highlight> ee qalabka howlaha adeeg
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Waxaan ku casuumeynaa xirfadlayaal, abuurayaal, iyo lammaanayaal helitaan hore. Tijaabi qalabka cusub marka hore, bixi jawaab-celin, kana caawi qaabeynta alaabo loogu talagalay howl adeeg oo dhab ah.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Baadh ururintayada fiidiyowyada iyo khayraadka kuwaas oo Baybalka nolol u keena sheekooyin iyo waxbaris soo jiidasho leh.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Ku biir safarkayaga Advent oo leh fiidiyow maalinle ah oo dhisa sugitaanka Kirismaska, isla markaana sahaminaya rajada, farxadda, iyo ballan-qaadka imaatinka Jesus.

welcomeStart.label: Iimaan & Qorniin
welcomeStart.title: Xulashada fiidiyowyada maanta
welcomeStart.description: Waxyaabo fiidiyow ah oo ku salaysan iimaan, kana yimid maktabaddeenna, si ay kuu dhiirrigeliyaan, kuu xujeeyaan, oo ay kuu kiciyaan fikir.

welcomeMorning.title: Subax wanaagsan! Qaybaha Baybalka ee maanta ayaa ku sugaya.
welcomeMorning.description: Ku bilow maalintaada qaybaha Baybalka ee dhiirrigeliya, kuwaas oo loo sameeyay inay ku xoojiyaan oo ay ruuxaaga kiciyaan.

welcomeAfternoon.label: Dhiirrigelinta galabnimo
welcomeAfternoon.title: Galab wanaagsan! Qaybaha Baybalka ee maalintaada.
welcomeAfternoon.description: Waxyaabo Baybal ah oo dhiirrigelin leh, ku habboon nasashadaada galabta ama dhiirrigelin sii socota.

welcomeEvening.label: Dhiirrigelinta fiidnimo
welcomeEvening.title: Habeen wanaagsan! Ku naso qaybaha Baybalka.
welcomeEvening.description: Qaybaha Baybalka ee deggan si ay kaaga caawiyaan inaad milicsato oo aad hesho qalbi qabow marka maalintaadu dhammaanayso.
